scope: Focused published-method check only; no expansion or training; no test37 access

sources.verified: Full publisher text. Methods: finite bounds treated as measurements then IQR filtering and averaging; strain discarded to species. Reproduced Witten CNN and BERT-AmPEP60; both better than ESM2 linear probe, modest neural gap. Does not establish strongest local baseline.

Full publisher text. Species-aware LLAMP; duplicates median, species genome and peptide model; condition-aware species prediction not novel by itself. No verified full strain/assay/censoring joint solution.

Indexed primary text explicitly mentions censoring statistics in oncocin mutagenesis. Full method NOT verified: PMC challenge, publisher403, EuropePMC API500; no retry. Do not label its estimator Tobit or neural conditional likelihood.
Publisher indexed title/abstract identifies interval-censored MIC distribution modeling, not peptide-sequence regression. Full text unavailable.
Publisher in-press abstract: entity median log2MIC, cluster-robust inference and censor/assay sensitivity. No accessible full method; not evidence of same conditional likelihood solution.

author_code_review.note: Source inspection only; CPU fallback observed; dependencies/weights/throughput not admitted or tested. No repository datasets read.

sampling_warning: 20 convenience root records cannot estimate full-database availability or censoring prevalence. 178 MIC rows not 178 independent peptides. Narrow46rows4peptides includes fungal targets and precedes chemistry/isolation checks. Each exact strain-medium stratum has at most one peptide.
single_candidate: After semantic/data/baseline admission only: same verified strongest reproducible point-regression backbone and identical conditional inputs, Gaussian scale, data, split, seeds and budget; replace boundary-point likelihood with correct observation likelihood. Mature statistical adaptation, not established novelty.
observation_rules: Model Y=logMIC conditional on verified chemistry/sequence, strain and observed assay fields. Do not synthesize missing metadata.
Point log density; right-bound log survival; left-bound log CDF; genuine interval log CDF difference. Assay dilution grid requires actual protocol.
Ranges across clinical isolates are not single-measurement intervals. Plus/minus requires SD/SE/CI and n definition before use.
Repeated measurements do not increase independent peptide count; preserve study/assay identities and use same grouped analysis in both arms. No simultaneous random-effects/architecture change.
Mass-to-molar conversion requires verified molecular identity and mass. auxiliary activity field is not a label replacement.
minimum_data_basis: Semantically resolved raw MIC, unit, verified chemistry, target and observed assay plus source and replicate linkage; adequate shared support without complete sequence-condition-source confounding.

Independent homology/chemical/source groups for fitting and untouched evaluation. Counts planned from paired group-level variance and a prespecified practically meaningful effect or CI width; no fixed arbitrary N.
Current N cannot estimate condition effects or reliable unseen-peptide gain. No full-database extrapolation.
go_criterion: Only revisit if data/chemistry/isolation pass, reproducible strong baseline fits CPU budget, and independent-group precision planning supports one frozen loss-change comparison. No benefit/safety/submission claim.
